description: Material corporate events from SEC 8-K filings, market-wide or for one company (ticker, CIK or name): filter by item (1.05 cybersecurity incident, 2.02 earnings, 5.02 executive change, 1.03 bankruptcy, 4.02 restatement... or names like cybersecurity, earnings), dates and words. Each event has company, tickers, filed and event dates, items with descriptions and the filing link. SEC EDGAR public data. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

company.description: Ticker, CIK or company name (default: all companies)

item.description: Comma list of 8-K items (1.05, 2.02, 5.02) or names (cybersecurity, earnings, exec-change, bankruptcy, acquisition, restatement)

q.description: Words to search in the filings

since.description: From date (default 7 days back, 1 year for a company)

name: sec_8k_events

notes.description: string, e.g. "8-Ks are due within 4 business days of the event. Item filt

source.description: string, e.g. "SEC EDGAR full-text search, 8-K filings (public data)"

title: Sec 8k events
